description: Fuel Economy of Passenger Cars in the Global South 2005-2019 is a data set listed in Transport Data Commons (Transport Data Catalogue), a transport data catalogue, published or maintained by UNEP. This dataset has been developed for the publicly available Fuel Economy of Passenger Cars in the Global South report from 2023 as part of the Global Fuel Economy Initiative. This dataset includes a wide range of indicators of the passenger car fleet for 113 countries across the globe (both developed economies and developing economies). Coverage: Algeria, Benin. The portal files it under the publisher UNEP. It offers 2 resource(s) in PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-05-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tdc-portal.
